pr_title: Add user state to SpectatorState, allowing multiplayer to continue to results
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14768

**Important: This requires an osu-server-spectator deploy with these changes present (won't crash without, just spectating won't work).**

I've tested this thoroughly using both multiplayer spectator and solo spectator, using more than one spectated client.

The commits are a little bit of a mess here but they're mostly compartmentalized  - some have already been extracted into other PRs (e.g. https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/16774), which makes the diff easy to read in a top-down fashion. Let me know if this is unacceptable and I'll rebase + re-PR.

- Moves passed/failed booleans into `GameplayState`, which is used to populate the new `SpectatorState.State` value. Also adds a new quit state to `GameplayState` for the same purpose.
- `SpectatingUserState` has a bunch of reasonable states, including two unused: `Idle` and `Paused`.
  - Not sure if we'll ever use `Idle` but it's a sane default imo.
  - `Paused` is completely unused/unimplemented but I hope that we can eventually, along with the `Failed` and `Quit` states, display some sort of message at the spectator's side for this state. I've added it in for now to prevent breaking changes down the line (from serialisation or enum ordering or otherwise).
- The `PlayingUsers` list has been removed and replaced by a new dictionary storing the states of every user currently being watched. Unlike the previously-exposed bindables, states don't get removed from this dictionary unless the user stops spectating. Instead, the states get updated with the new `SpectatingUserState` value upon `UserBeganPlaying`/`UserFinishedPlaying`.
- One particular change of importance otherwise is `MultiSpectatorScreen`, which ignores stopping gameplay in `Passed`/`Failed` user states.
pr_comments: Tested this today using the whole-nine-yards setup. Seems to work well.
Is the spectator server deploy intended to be backwards compatible with existing releases?

Current osu! + updated osu-server-spectator -> Compatible
Updated osu! + current osu-server-spectator -> Not compatible (spectating won't work, but no crash)
Cool, so to confirm it's safe to immediately deploy?

issue_context.title: Multiplayer spectator always stops right before ending the beatmap
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** As per title, happened all the 3 times i spectated in that room and someone else there also confirmed it.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53081750/133654702-0391d016-73ea-4262-8e63-65aa0a006aa3.mp4

**osu!lazer version:** 2021.916.0-lazer
comments:
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1152550974

A couple of friends and I did a multiplayer test yesterday
In addition to the bug mentioned in this issue, here were a couple notable observations.

- Team VS does not sort by team - it would be nice to for blue team to be on one side and red team on another (it sorts top to bottom, left to right)
- Some players couldn't be spectated at all.
- Crashes happened on the first map (can't provide any logs though)
Bumping this up to p0 as I've been told this is a blocker for more serious tournaments being run/streamed using lazer

I can confirm that spectator client stops EXACTLY when all players finish the map: https://youtu.be/DDVeIYY3pYw?t=2070
Player log: [runtime.log.txt](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7917669/runtime.log.txt)
Spectator log: [runtime.log.txt](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7917672/runtime.log.txt)

review_comments: While I'm not too fussed about this, I think reusing the `SpecatingUserState` here could work better, given that all of these boolean properties should be mutually exclusive. Could be left as a follow-up change though.

Disagree. `SpectatingUserState` contains several other enum members which make no sense in the context of `GameplayState` (`Idle`, for one). If this were to happen then it would have to be a separate enum (`GameplayCompletionState`?)

If there is insistence on keeping one enum then it probably shouldn't contain `Idle` in its set of values and not have the `Spectating` prefix. And even then the `Playing`/`Paused` states would need to be properly supported.
The `Playing` state would be the default state, and `Paused` sounds not too hard to support (that's one reason why I think it can be left as a follow-up change though).

I've answered this as well in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/16827#discussion_r802238387. Combining it into this class seems like a fair idea, but it's a larger change that touches many files which I'm not comfortable in piling up in this PR.
